scripts.dev: infisical run --env=dev --path=/mandau-kemenag -- concurrently -n "BE,FE" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold" "cd backend && air" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.dev:prod: infisical run --env=prod --path=/mandau-kemenag -- concurrently -n "BE,FE" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold" "cd backend && air" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.dev:backend:go: infisical run --env=dev --path=/mandau-kemenag -- cd backend && go run main.go
scripts.dev:frontend: infisical run --env=dev --path=/mandau-kemenag -- cd frontend && npm run dev
scripts.build:frontend: infisical run --env=prod --path=/mandau-kemenag -- cd frontend && npm run build
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && go build -o api-mandau main.go
